packageRules.description: Wait 7 days before updating uv dependencies, matching exclude-newer in pyproject.toml. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
Update main uv dependencies weekly. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
Update uv dev and test dependency groups monthly. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Propose .python-version updates in their own PR twice a year
schedule: before 4am on the first day of january and july

packageRules.description: requires-python is raised by hand when dropping support for an old Python
Wait 7 days before updating JavaScript dependencies, matching npmMinimalAgeGate in ui/.yarnrc.yml. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
Update main JavaScript dependencies weekly. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
Update JavaScript dev dependencies and yarn monthly. Security updates skip this and are raised immediately.
schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Propose Node.js image version updates in their own PR twice a year
schedule: before 4am on the first day of january and july

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh uv.lock, including git sources and transitive dependencies, monthly. Renovate cannot group this with other updates. uv's exclude-newer in pyproject.toml applies the 7 day cooldown.
schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month
